about.en: OKZOO is a decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN) project that distributes portable AIoT devices with environmental sensors, paired with AI pet companions, to build an urban-scale environmental data network. AIOT is its reward and staking token, a BEP-20 token on BNB Smart Chain (contract 0x55ad16bd573b3365f43a9daeb0cc66a73821b4a5) with a supply of 1 billion.
